title: OEB Pick Tracker Pro
description: Wave 2 of the Options Edge Brief - daily deterministic mark-to-market of every open OEB pick. Reads the IMMUTABLE pick journal at indexes/IMMUTABLE/ag_picks/, identifies picks not yet closed (no matching idea_id in indexes/IMMUTABLE/ag_picks_closures/), and for each open pick fetches the current snapshot of every leg from Massive.com /v3/snapshot/options/{ticker}/{contract}, sums the signed mid prices into a current net debit/credit, and applies the EXACT exit rules carried on the pick (stop_loss_price / take_profit_price / suggested_sell_epoch / contract expiration). When a pick hits an exit rule it writes a closure event via log_ag_pick_closure() with deterministic provenance: outcome (won/lost/time_exit/expired), trigger_rule, signed P&L per 1 contract (price math, not position math, so the metric is stable across the user's $1000-$1M account-growth horizon), pnl_pct_vs_max_loss (-100 = full loss, +100 = full max profit), closure_quality (clean / illiquid / gap_through_stop / expired_otm / expired_itm), and the leg prices at close as JSON for forensic analysis. Picks still in the still-open band remain untouched (no closure event written). The tracker carries account_size_floor_usd through to the closure so the weekly performance review can compute hit_rate_overall AND hit_rate_account_fit. Cron 30 21 * * 1-5 (post-close ~17:30 ET). Single-script API budget scales with open picks: ~1 call per leg per open pick, ~10 picks * 1-4 legs typically = 10-40 calls per run, trivial on Massive Starter unlimited tier. Hindsight-free by design - exit prices are evaluated against the rules-as-they-existed-at-entry, never re-evaluated.
